title: When the Wreck Turns
author: Dominic Sterling
blurb: Ulyana Amberdale, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
